{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.58

|gr1= Mods and Addons
|gr2= Config

|descr= Returns an array of addons ([[CfgPatches]]) in which the given config class is defined.

|s1= [[configSourceAddonList]] config

|p1= config: [[Config]]

|r1= [[Array]] of [[String]]s

|x1= <sqf>_addons = configSourceAddonList (configFile >> "CfgVehicles" >> "Man"); // returns ["A3_Data_F", "A3_Characters_F", "A3_Data_F_Curator", "A3_Air_F_Heli"]</sqf>

|seealso= [[configFile]] [[configSourceMod]] [[configSourceModList]]
}}
